commands.name: database
commands.description: Database utilities.

commands.name: backup
commands.description: Create a backup of a PostgreSQL database using pg_dump.

options.name: --all
options.description: Backup all databases on the server. Each database will have its own .dump file. [default: False]

options.name: --password
options.description: Database password. If not provided, will be prompted interactively.

options.name: --output
options.description: Output file path (for single database) or folder path (for --all). If not provided, uses current directory.

options.name: --exclude-table-data
options.description: Exclude table data matching the specified pattern(s). Can be specified multiple times. Example: --exclude-table-data 'log*'

arguments.name: DATABASE
arguments.description: Name of the database to backup. Not required when using --all.

commands.name: restore
commands.description: Restore a PostgreSQL database using pg_restore.

options.name: --all
options.description: Restore all databases from dump files in the specified directory. [default: False]

options.name: --directory
options.description: Directory containing .dump files (for --all). If not provided, uses current directory.

options.name: --password
options.description: Database password. If not provided, will be prompted interactively.

arguments.name: DATABASE
arguments.description: Name of the database to restore. Not required when using --all.

arguments.name: FILE
arguments.description: Path to the dump file to restore. If not provided, looks for <database>.dump in the current directory.

commands.name: pgpass
commands.description: Gerencia o arquivo pgpass.conf para autenticação PostgreSQL sem senha.

commands.name: add
commands.description: Adiciona uma nova entrada de credencial PostgreSQL ao pgpass.conf.

options.name: --password
options.description: Senha PostgreSQL. Se não fornecida, será solicitada interativamente.

options.name: --host
options.description: Hostname ou endereço IP do servidor PostgreSQL.

arguments.name: BANCO
arguments.description: Nome do banco de dados (ou * para curinga).

commands.name: list
commands.description: Lista todas as entradas do pgpass.conf com senhas mascaradas.

commands.name: remove
commands.description: Remove uma entrada específica do pgpass.conf.

arguments.name: BANCO
arguments.description: Nome do banco de dados da entrada a remover (ou * para curinga).

commands.name: query
commands.description: Execute SQL queries and export results to CSV.

commands.name: run
commands.description: Run a SQL query and export the results to CSV.

options.name: --input
options.description: Path to the SQL input file.

options.name: --output
options.description: Path to the CSV output file (or directory when using --all).

options.name: --database
options.description: Database name. Not required when using --all.

options.name: --password
options.description: Database password. If not provided, will be prompted interactively.

options.name: --ssl-mode
options.description: SSL mode (Disable, Allow, Prefer, Require, VerifyCA, VerifyFull). Default: Prefer.

options.name: --all
options.description: Execute the query on all databases on the server. [default: False]

options.name: --separate-files
options.description: Generate separate CSV files for each database instead of a single consolidated file. [default: False]

options.name: --exclude
options.description: Comma-separated list of database names to exclude (e.g., postgres,template0,template1).

options.name: --servers
options.description: Execute the query on all servers configured in appsettings.json. [default: False]

options.name: --server-filter
options.description: Filter servers by name pattern (supports * wildcard). Example: 'prod-*' or '*-primary'.

commands.name: clean

arguments.name: DIRECTORY
